summary: Builds the filtered, merge-sorted scene-file linked list. Clears the object's existing list, then either copies every non-null entry from the global scene list (dword_8AC490, dword_8AC488 entries, stride 396) when no filter string is given, the filter equals the default byte_5EA438, or a photo/free-camera mode is active; or parses a filter expression with AND:/OR:/NOT: token buckets, materializes include/AND lists and removes NOT tokens, then splits the list at the midpoint and merge-sorts it back together with SceneSortComparator. Returns the accumulated node counter. Called by GameFilterSetup.

local_names.this: filtered scene list object: head at +8, tail at +12, cursor at +16, node count at +20, state counter at +24
local_names.a2: filter expression string (null or equal to the default for the unfiltered path)
local_names.v32: running node counter used as the build result
local_names.v30: token mode selector (0 include, 1 OR/AND, 2 NOT) chosen by prefix classification
local_names.v45: 256-byte working copy of the filter expression

operations.description: Clears the object's existing scene list via ResourceListCleanup_62c0 before rebuilding
Unfiltered path: taken when a2 is null, a2 equals the default path string byte_5EA438, or the mode flags dword_7D0398 is set with dword_7D0410 not equal to 5
Sets the active filter string to the default byte_5EA438 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc
Walks the global scene list: dword_8AC488 entries starting at dword_8AC490 with a stride of 396 bytes, processing each entry whose pointer is non-null
Per entry: clears a 256-byte name buffer, then StringCopyWithValidation copies the scene name from aFilterProperti into it (max 256, source at entry plus 260 bytes)

Allocates and builds the list node: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16) for the scene object initialized by sub_4C5C80 with the copied name, then OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) for the link cell storing the scene pointer, a null next and a flag byte of 1

Appends the new node: when the head (this+8) exists, the old tail's next pointer (*(this+12)+4) is set to the new node; otherwise head (this+8) and cursor (this+16) both become it; tail (this+12), node count (this+20) and the local counter are then updated
Filtered path: sets the active filter string to a2 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and records the OR/alternative marker string stored at dword_5D30C0
Copies the filter expression into a 256-byte working buffer with a cap of 255 via sub_587DD0, then zeroes the three token buckets (two 50-dword arrays and a 253-byte buffer)
Tokenizes the filter buffer with strtok-style calls to sub_5897CA using the delimiter set ' ,tab newline'; iteration continues while a token is returned

Classifies each token with sub_588410 prefix tests against the AND marker, the OR marker (dword_5D30C0) and the NOT marker; the failing branch selects the include (v43), AND (v44) or NOT (v40) bucket and sets the mode counter (0, 1 or 2). Tokens are stored while the chosen bucket holds fewer than 49 entries

Materializes the filtered list: FilterPropertiesListBuilder adds the include tokens, FilterPropertiesListBuilder_5fd0 the AND tokens, and FilterPropertiesListNodeRemover removes the NOT tokens from the built list

Sort preparation: counts the nodes from the head (this+8); when at least 2 exist, walks to the midpoint, writes 0 to the midpoint node's next pointer (at the tail base (this+12) node plus 4) to split the list into two halves
Merge-sorts each half with MergeSortLinkedList and merges the two runs back together using SceneSortComparator to order the nodes
Rebuilds list bookkeeping: head (this+8), tail (this+12) walked to the last node, cursor (this+16), resets the state counter this+24 to 0, and returns the accumulated node counter from the build
Invoked by GameFilterSetup to produce the filtered scene list for the current filter configuration
